body:
## Question
Are **all T07-ratified instituted-knowledge records** developed as full Episteme pages, including the final concept census rather than only the pre-capstone developed concept directory?

## Context
Episteme can include sources, histories, etymologies, lenses, maps/paths, dossiers, figures, concepts, dialogues and any other record types actually ratified. Consume the propagated whole-field census; do not preserve old subtree counts by inertia.

The recovered `symbolon/episteme/concepts/reference-notes/` shelf is mandatory provenance/census input. Its roughly ninety recovered notes are **not automatically concepts**, but every note must already have a T07 disposition and named carrier before this ticket closes. Where the census promotes one to a concept/history/dossier/path/etc., develop that canonical record; where it merges/re-homes, verify the surviving page actually carries the unique operation.

Concept pages are controlled definitions of terms doing recurrent argumentative work; they are not catch-all summaries and are not created merely because a term occurs frequently. Source-facing pages surface canonical `SOURCE.md` houses in our voice without duplicating passage cards or transferring source authority.

Each field page begins from raw `#0/#1/#2/#3/#4/#5→0`, with local sixfold semantics derived from the record's actual operation, register subtype, relations and ratified office. No universal semantic headings.

Figures land in `episteme/figures/` where declared. Large subtrees may be batched by sub-domain, but batching does not change census identity or allow a recovered item to disappear.

## Done when

Every ratified Episteme record has one developed canonical page; every recovered reference note can be traced to that page or to its explicitly ratified non-page/merge/rehome disposition; sub-domain contracts are satisfied; source/provenance/claim boundaries are intact; figures exist where declared; and hygiene + census-backcheck are green.
title: T21 — P2 — episteme pages + figures
